$Comment: Santa's Favorite: reach Exalted on Santa's Nice List, the rank the list calls Santa's Favorite.
Earned once and kept. Favor on the Nice List carries from one Christmas to the next, so this file has
no Parent: the yearly skeleton would mint a copy each year that every Exalted player collects again at
login for nothing. It carries no merry tag either, which keeps it out of the Merrymaker.
REPUTATION_RANK credits every rank a player's favor has reached, each time their favor changes and when
they log in. Target is the rank id and Qualifier the reputation id. The criterion's TextKey words the
step with the list's own rank name. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_santas_favorite, and
its words come from the keys that id spells. It is the top of Santa's rank gifts, after On the List,
It pays the title Christmas_Santas_Favorite through the Title reward kind, on unlock: a title is the
one thing an achievement pays without waiting to be collected. Its gift waits in Rewards.Claim on the
achievements page: Christmas Coins, and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Boost_Token, half again as much XP in
every skill for two hours, which the player starts when it suits them. The token row's own Requires,
